task: Audit the List Directory Layout for brand, content, and UX/tech compliance.

findings.reasoning: The Tailwind configuration defines marigold as #EAA92A and custom CSS uses #EAA92A. However, the Brand Playbook specifies Marigold / Burnt Honey as #C97138. Confidence: high.
The Tailwind configuration assigns the 'Inter' font to 'label-caps' (used for eyebrows). The Brand Playbook mandates 'IBM Plex Mono' for eyebrows and labels. Confidence: high.
The word 'immersive' is used in the Emerging Leaders Programme description ('immersive workshops'). 'immersive' is explicitly listed as a banned word in the Voice & Tone guidelines. Confidence: high.
findings.element: article for Emerging Leaders Programme (paragraph text)
findings.required: replace with an active verb or concrete noun

findings.reasoning: Row 3 (Emerging Leaders) uses a hardcoded background color of #EBE5D6. This is not in the approved palette (Parchment is #F4EFE3). Confidence: high.
Section 4.1 specifies PCAIM duration is 10 months. HTML shows 12 WEEKS.
findings.detail: PCAIM duration should be 10 months, not 12 WEEKS.

findings.reasoning: Section 4.2 specifies PCHM duration is 10 months. HTML shows 6 MONTHS.
findings.detail: PCHM duration should be 10 months, not 6 MONTHS.

findings.reasoning: Section 4.3 specifies ELP duration is 7 months. HTML shows 1 YEAR.
findings.detail: ELP duration should be 7 months, not 1 YEAR.

findings.reasoning: The Directory Stats section contains fabricated metrics (14 Faculties, 250+ Alumni, 05 Campuses, 98% Placement). The playbook specifically states PCHM has no formal placement.
findings.detail: Fabricated stats in Directory Stats section (98% Placement Rate, 14 Faculties, 05 Campuses).

findings.reasoning: The prompt says 'Checks: Mandatory sections present (Hero, Faculty, FAQs)'. The file lacks Faculty and FAQs. However, since this is a listing page, they might not be required. Flagging for safety.
findings.detail: Missing Faculty and FAQs sections. These are mandatory per general rules, though potentially not applicable for a directory page.

findings.reasoning: The header element inside main acts as the above-fold section but lacks a 2-column layout (CSS Grid or Flexbox) as mandated by the VIEWPORT_SPEC. However, because it is just a text header without a right-side card, enforcing a grid directly on it might break the text flow, so confidence is low.
findings.issue: Hero or above-fold section does not use CSS Grid or Flexbox with at least 2 explicit columns at desktop.

findings.reasoning: The section element for directory stats uses py-stack-lg which computes to 32px padding, but the VIEWPORT_SPEC requires section vertical padding to be at least 60px at desktop.
findings.issue: Section vertical padding is 32px, below the 60px minimum at desktop.

findings.reasoning: The img tag uses a 'data-alt' attribute instead of the standard 'alt' attribute, which is required for accessibility.
The document head is missing a meta description and Open Graph tags.
findings.issue: Missing meta description and Open Graph tags.
findings.fix: add meta description and Open Graph tags
